name: Demo Filer (Senior)
narrative: Retired senior citizen (63) with pension income of Rs 4,80,000/year and fixed deposit interest of Rs 1,90,000 (194A TDS deducted by the bank). Low digital literacy, prefers the Hindi UI. Filing purely to claim a TDS refund. Common misconception: seniors assume the old regime is always best because of 80TTB, but here the new regime's higher 87A rebate threshold (Rs 12L) actually gives a bigger refund.
